# AioCast

> Free tools for solo podcasters: paste show notes or a transcript, get an SEO blog draft, FAQ blocks, and social scripts for your own website. No login required for the free daily limit.

AioCast helps indie podcast hosts turn one episode into indexable, structured text — for Google search and for AI answer engines that cite clear FAQ-style content.

## Core tools

- [Paste notes → blog draft (no login)](https://aiocast.com/tools/free-show-notes-generator): Paste show notes or transcript text → structured SEO blog draft + FAQ + social scripts. SEO landing page title: Free AI Show Notes Generator.
- [SEO growth pack](https://aiocast.com/tools/seo-growth-pack): Main generator — paste notes or upload a short audio clip. Output includes show-notes clean (summary, chapters, platform blurbs), article, FAQ, and copy-ready BlogPosting/PodcastEpisode/FAQ JSON-LD.
- [Show notes to HTML](https://aiocast.com/tools/show-notes-to-html): Convert a show notes outline to paste-ready HTML.
- [Podcast title generator](https://aiocast.com/tools/free-podcast-title-generator): Search-friendly episode title ideas.

## Guides & resources

- [Podcast show notes for SEO](https://aiocast.com/guides/podcast-show-notes-for-seo): Timestamps only when real, FAQ, schema on your domain.
- [Podcast show notes template](https://aiocast.com/guides/show-notes-template): Free copy-paste format for podcast show notes.
- [How to turn a podcast into a blog post](https://aiocast.com/guides/podcast-to-blog-post): Step-by-step workflow with embedded generator.
- [Podcast FAQ for SEO](https://aiocast.com/guides/podcast-faq-for-seo): Grounded FAQ blocks and schema tips.
- [Podcast to blog SEO checklist](https://aiocast.com/resources/podcast-to-blog-seo-checklist): Pre-publish checklist.
- [Pre-flight recording checklist](https://aiocast.com/resources/pre-flight-checklist): Room noise, gain, backups before you hit Record.
- [Resources hub](https://aiocast.com/resources): Guides and checklists index.
- [Sample growth pack output](https://aiocast.com/examples/sample-growth-pack): Example blog structure, FAQ, show notes, and social scripts.

## Who it is for

Solo podcasters and small teams without a dedicated editor who want to publish searchable text on their own domain — not inside Spotify or Apple Podcasts only. AioCast consumes text you already have (notes/transcript); it is not a full-episode audio transcription product.

## Pricing

Free: 3 pack generations per day per IP (no account required). Schema JSON-LD copy is included on free results. Pro optional for unlimited runs and full pack history.
